description: §22.12 closed attribute list (PA-ruled S459: meta descriptive attrs; http-equiv refused) positive — compile-time `emit()` output may carry `<meta>`'s descriptive attributes (`name`, `content`, `property`, `media`); they reach the rendered document.
rationale: §22.12 *Attributes — a CLOSED list*: on `<meta>`, `name` / `content` / `charset` / `property` / `itemprop` / `media` are admitted; `content` is element-scoped and safe only because `http-equiv` is refused.
